Docs.param: The exact time at which the plan starts.

Docs.summary: Start defining a SubscriptionPlan that starts at a specific time, and automatically recurs after each specific period of time, repeating indefinitely.

remarks.para: Start defining a SubscriptionPlan that starts at a specific time, and automatically recurs after each specific period of time, repeating indefinitely. When the given period is set to exactly one month, the plan will always recur on the day of the month defined by ZonedDateTime.getDayOfMonth(). When a particular month ends before this day, the plan will recur on the last possible instant of that month.
